stem.text: When X is added to $\text{NaOH(aq)}$ and heated under reflux, pentan-2-ol is made.
Which organic product is made when X is heated with a solution of $\text{KCN}$ dissolved in ethanol?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: a five-carbon zig-zag chain with a CN group on the end carbon.

B.alt: Skeletal formula: a four-carbon branched chain with a CN group on the branch carbon.

C.alt: Skeletal formula: a six-carbon zig-zag chain with a CN group on the end carbon.

D.alt: Skeletal formula: a six-carbon branched chain with a CN group on the branch carbon.
